methodology.clock: Resolve mandatory choices; set allowed focus; three real beats, accept moments only in B; one shared shop window before tick. No RNG for policies. All real states checked after each action.
methodology.choices: Same economy-t8a hash, explicit legal targets and first-available fallback. Strict Saver excludes paid story choices/purchases; StoryHelper alters only family-need-cell-* using predeclared reserve/context rules.
methodology.timing: Living checkpoints after settlement, before the new pending choice. Terminal settlement belongs to lifetime accounting, never to surviving-age distributions.
methodology.conflicts: Historical T8a five-offer metric retained; full catalogue supplies retraining target. Full financial/attention pairs use distinct expense categories, actual purchase sequences. Narrative mutual exclusivity and three-year projected commitment risk are separate.
methodology.narrative: T7 real event IDs, content conditions, age, presence and moment cooldown/attention. Offered != accepted. Purchase records/diary lines do not count as narrative. Eligible-not-selected aggregates rhythm, selection RNG and competing events; not a causal Director diagnosis.
methodology.forecast: Three projectYear calls with known child ageing; no hypothetical stories, world shocks, skill growth or mortality. New risk requires previously safe baseline plus aid/cancellation/housing loss or <one-year buffer with negative flow.
limits: Formal availability is not human attractiveness.
T7 has no direct retraining hook; profession-specific content is measured separately.
Course echo requires the story-window purchase, not every ordinary course.
Delayed definitions use since/ownedYears; deaths before age/lag floor are only a necessary timing bound.
Counts of blocked years can overlap within a year; no exclusive causal decomposition is claimed.
All lifetime means include infant deaths; paired survivor counts are explicit.
